contract: Time in seconds = amount in bytes * 8 / (rate in bits per second * utilization / 100). Decimal prefixes use powers of 1000; binary prefixes use powers of 1024; B denotes bytes, b bits. Require explicit utilization, positive rate, nonnegative size, and utilization in (0,100]. No congestion, startup or changing-throughput prediction.

transfer-ambiguous.reason: lowercase gb/mbps does not establish intended bit/byte convention

transfer-missing.reason: request utilization or explicitly state idealized full-throughput assumption
